name: search-bar
title: Search bar
description: The ad's search bar: a Black field with the brand corner, the prompt in White DM Sans and a White Search button inside it. Enter or the button runs the search.
use_for: The one search of a page or a product view: searching creatives, ads, brands and creators by asking in words. Usually the first thing on the page, often over the brand light.
never: Two search bars on one page
A colored search button: it is the White primary button
The search bar inside a card
source: Brand assets (Figma page 8): Ad, The only creative search engine: Search bar (952x88, radius 10, Black), Button, Search (136x56, 16px in), prompt in White DM Sans 24px
